half: the three services and their secrets). **Cited (context, owned
elsewhere):** SIG-SEC-009 (secret lifecycle — P35.4), SIG-OPS-005
(live-configuration reconciliation — P35.1a). **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/251_P34.42a__least-privilege-service-identities.md`
(manifest row 251, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.41-withdrawal-barrier-bytes` (stacked, H2 PR-1) · **Gate:** the
S5-3 11A list names "P34.42a/b (IAM)" — pre-authorised (expires GATE-G4;
voided-by a red probe, a failed restore point, or a production read that
contradicts a record) · **Live stage:** production write (IAM: service
accounts, bindings, secret accessors; one same-image revision per

first slot ≥ 2026-10-13T12:00Z, never 03:00–06:30Z; re-run with the
contract's verbatim prompt, scope the IAM leg only) · **CI config
changed:** no.

## Why

The three Cloud Run services (`sig-api`, `sig-web`, `sig-alerts`) run as
the project-Editor default compute identity (G1-01 / F-272 — the
dominant runtime security risk): one SA with `roles/editor` can delete
the spine, the evidence stores and every secret, and `sig-alerts` is
invokable by `allUsers` on top of that. SIG-SEC-007 forbids workloads on
basic roles. This is the services half of the remediation — the 88 jobs
and the `roles/editor` removal itself are P34.42b.

## What ships

- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — the committed declaration
  (`sig.iam-identities/1`), DATA not code: the three runtime SAs
  (`sig-api-rt`, `sig-web-rt`, `sig-alerts-rt`), the service→SA map, the
  least-privilege bindings (`cloudsql.client` for api; `objectViewer` on
  the web bucket for web; nothing for alerts), the 11-secret consumer
  matrix (one new accessor: `sig-api-rt` on `sig-pg-password`; the
  compute SA keeps its declared grants until P34.42b; `sig-api-env`
  recorded with 0 consumers, never deleted here), the `sig-alerts`
  invoker change (grant the recorded caller, revoke `allUsers`), and
  symbolic members (`default-compute`, `operator`) — never a project id
  or number literal.
- **`ops/src/ops/iam_identities.py`** + `sig-ops iam
  plan|diff|check-revisions` (cli.py wiring) — the offline engine:
  fail-closed TOML parse (a basic role, a public grant, an undeclared
  SA, or a named `allUsers` outside a revoke list refuses), the ordered
  plan with per-step rollbacks, the read-only snapshot diff (missing
  SA/binding/accessor, wrong runtime SA, lingering `allUsers`, a
  declared SA holding an undeclared/basic role, a non-consumer member
  on a secret, a public member with more than viewer on a declared
  bucket), and the same-image-revision gate (the leg changes identity
  only — digests must be byte-identical).
- **`ops/gcp/iam-service-accounts.sh`** — the windowed leg
  (dry-run-by-default): `prestate` (project/secret/service IAM +
  describes + route byte-compare baseline) → `identities` → `bindings`
  → `revisions` (`gcloud run services update --service-account`, image
  untouched) → `invoker` → `verify`/`analysis`
  (`sig-ops iam diff` + `check-revisions` + policy-troubleshooter —
  read-only proof each runtime SA lacks delete on the spine/evidence
  stores and every foreign secret; a GRANTED answer is a hard fail) →
  `rollback` (everything from the recorded prestate). `--apply` is
  ADC-gated and window-gated: before 2026-10-13T12:00Z or inside
  03:00–06:30Z it exits **42** with the verbatim re-run prompt; apply
  without ADC exits **3**; check mode makes zero network calls.
  `--verify --from-state DIR` diffs a recorded snapshot offline.
- **`ops/gcp/config.sh`** — `SIG_SA_{API,WEB,ALERTS}` + derived emails
  + `SIG_IAM_EARLIEST`/`SIG_IAM_STATE_DIR` (+ `SIG_IAM_NOW` test hook).
- **`ops/gcp/web.sh`, `ops/gcp/provision.sh`, `ops/src/ops/deploy.py`**
  — every deploy path now names `--service-account` explicitly (AR-8):
  `sig-web` → `sig-web-rt`, `sig-api` → `sig-api-rt`. Check-mode
  placeholder emails re-derived after `require_project` (the
  `sig-*-rt@.iam…`/`gs://-sig-web` cosmetic fixed in the same pass).
- **`ops/gcp/README.md`** — the new script row.

## Boundaries

**No production mutation ran or runs in this PR** — the IAM leg is
queued: apply inside the freeze exits 42 naming the verbatim re-run
command `implement-spec
spec=docs/tickets/251_P34.42a__least-privilege-service-identities.md
live_verification=true` (scope: the IAM leg only). `roles/editor` on
the default compute SA is untouched (P34.42b). The 88 jobs are
untouched. No secret value is read, copied or committed — the
declaration carries names and IAM references only. No public response
changes: `sig-api`/`sig-web` stay public; `sig-alerts` loses
`allUsers` but its `sig-probe` caller is granted `run.invoker` (its
current compute identity — P34.42b swaps the member, not the
mechanism). No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick, no spine
UPDATE/DELETE, `db/sqitch.plan` 44–52 untouched, no living-record
assertion, no e-mail address anywhere.

Out of scope held: job SAs + `roles/editor` removal (P34.42b),
execution-host/DB logins (P34.43), daily live-diff alerting (P35.1a —
the `diff` engine is designed to be reused there), secret rotation
records (P35.4), Cloud Armor (P36.13), evidence retention (P37.3).
